title: Eric Davis calls Townsend Brown a phony

tellings.quote: um Eric Davis got in touch with me and was like Towns and Brown is a a phony.

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, known for claims that electricity could make objects move without propellers or rockets, was a phony, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis, who has worked on government UFO studies. Michels tells this himself, in a talk with the UFO activist Steven Greer, saying Davis contacted him directly to say so. It matters because Brown is often cited as an early pioneer of antigravity.
